item.title: 2011 Land Rover Range Rover HSE at No Reserve
item.description: This 2011 Land Rover Range Rover HSE was initially sold in California, remained registered in the state until 2023, was sold on BaT in December 2023, and was acquired by the current owner in 2024. Finished in Nara Bronze over Arabica leather, the truck is powered by a 5.0-liter V8 that drives all four wheels through a six-speed automatic transmission, a dual-range transfer case, and an electronic locking center differential. item.title: 1969 Ford Bronco
item.description: This 1969 Ford Bronco was refurbished and modified in 2015, including a repaint in Nardo Grey and the installation of an MSD electronic fuel injection system, Hedman headers, 15" Pro Comp wheels, front disc brakes, and suspension and body lifts. It is powered by a replacement 302ci V8 linked to a four-speed automatic transmission and a twin-stick, dual-range transfer case. item.title: Porsche Classic Restoration Challenge 1997 Porsche 911 Carrera Cabriolet 6-Speed
item.description: This 1997 Porsche 911 Carrera cabriolet was acquired in 2022 as a non-running project by the seller, Porsche Bakersfield in California, and refurbished as part of the 2025 Porsche Classic Restoration Challenge. Work involved repainting the body Riviera Blue, rebuilding and resealing the the 3.6-liter flat-six, refreshing the brakes, mounting Michelin Pilot Sport tires, replacing the exhaust system, retrimming the interior, and fitting a Porsche Classic Communications head unit. item.title: 43k-Mile 1997 Ferrari F355 Spider 6-Speed

item.title: 2007 Ferrari F430 Spider
item.description: This 2007 Ferrari F430 Spider is finished in Nero Daytona over black and red leather and is powered by a 4.3-liter DOHC V8 linked to a six-speed F1 automated transaxle and a limited-slip differential. item.title: 1995 BMW M3 AC Schnitzer ACS3 CLS
item.description: This 1995 BMW M3 is #7 of a reported 75 that were converted to ACS3 CLS (Coupe Lightweight Silhouette) specification by AC Schnitzer. item.title: 1989 Porsche 911 Turbo Coupe
item.description: This 1989 Porsche 911 Turbo coupe was ordered new through Carlsen Porsche of Palo Alto, California, in Velvet Red Metallic over a Cashmere Beige interior with sport seats.
